summary: Official institutional evidence establishes a Laghouat wilaya cadastre directorate and references National Cadastre ArcGIS data, but bounded anonymous requests to the official FADAELDJAZAIR and ASGA viewer hosts timed out. No public parcel schema, CRS, safe native ID, or polygon geometry was verified.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and French discovery was performed and recorded in city-3497-laghouat.json. The official Journal officiel and ANESRIF document were inspected. Live anonymous GETs to the official portal and ASGA viewer were bounded at 20 seconds and timed out; no credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe lookup, or TLS-verification disablement was used.
cityOrLocalCustodian: The Direction du cadastre de wilaya de Laghouat is directly evidenced by the official Journal officiel. ANESRIF project material also references National Cadastre ArcGIS data in the Laghouat-Ghardaïa area. These are custodian/institutional references, not proof that the inspected public viewer exposes a citywide anonymous parcel layer.
routesAttempted: All route URLs, methods, bounded outcomes, and source scopes are recorded in city-3497-laghouat.json.
